drivers.theme: Yields at multi-decade highs (30y ~5.5%, 10y ~5.25%) capping valuations
Hawkish Fed repricing: 3-4 hikes priced, 'modest further tightening'
Equity resilience - 3-day S&P win streak, weekly gain despite bond rout
AI capex momentum (Akamai $12bn Anthropic compute deal)
Crude retreating on Hormuz talks but stalemate; weekend geopolitical risk
Diesel export ban debate, inflation/election risk

parsed.rationale: Bonds stabilizing after a multi-decade yield selloff, with equities showing unusual resilience and Nasdaq futures leading. Hawkish Fed pricing and high long yields remain a persistent valuation headwind, offset by AI deal flow; mild positive drift, limited conviction given weekend oil/diplomacy risk.
